reg.name: reg-bellman-descent
reg.network_output: softplus cost-to-go V_hat, normalised by the training scale S = 897803.25
reg.descent: from u, among free neighbours with V(v) < V(u) (V(goal) = 0), choose argmin V(v) + kappa * 30 * l(u,v) / S
reg.fallback: on a local minimum, geometric Dijkstra (costs l) from the goal over reversed edges until it settles any visited descent cell; route = descent prefix to that cell + Dijkstra branch to the goal
reg.parameters_selected_on: calibration split, 256, 1024 scenes; rule fixed beforehand: minimise regret p90, ties by fallback count; kappa grid {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64}
